# 0.36.1
- Remove handoff-status and saved-note icons from session cards and their icon-guide entries. - Keep draft freshness guidance within handoff review. Project note counts remain beside the Project notes action in Session Info; continuation links remain in session history.
## Public preview update (since 0.19.3)
- Work with coding agents in embedded terminals, with clearer running, waiting and closed states. - Open standalone shell terminals in compact tabs; keep shell terminals and agent conversations linked where detected. - Inspect project changes with readable diffs and open files in your preferred editor. - Review scoped project changes with another agent without embedding the entire diff in the launch prompt. - Follow reported agent checklists and an attention inbox, with project preferences and optional isolated workspaces. - Save project notes for reusable knowledge, or session reports for a record of the work. Continue conversations with reviewed handoffs. - Simplified navigation, collapsible side panes, terminal themes, and a new RunHuddle icon.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or newer. Install and sign in to your agent CLIs separately. Agent checklists appear only when the provider reports a supported structured plan. Project changes belong to the working folder and can include edits from multiple sessions. This is a preview; review generated notes and handoffs before reusing them.
